name: wordnet-workspace
description: WordNet TypeScript implementation with demo and benchmarks
author: fustilio

scripts.build: pnpm --filter wn-ts-node build && pnpm --filter wn-ts-web build
scripts.ci:benchmark: echo '📊 Running benchmark functional tests...' && pnpm benchmark:func && echo '📊 Running benchmark parity tests...' && pnpm benchmark:parity && echo '📊 Running benchmark performance tests...' && pnpm benchmark:perf
scripts.ci:build: echo '🔨 Building wn-ts library...' && pnpm build
scripts.ci:demo: echo '🎭 Running all demo use cases...' && pnpm demo:all-use-cases
scripts.ci:full: pnpm run ci:build && pnpm run ci:test && pnpm run ci:demo && pnpm run ci:benchmark
scripts.ci:test: echo '🧪 Running wn-ts tests...' && pnpm test && echo '🧪 Running wn-ts e2e tests...' && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test: pnpm test:core && pnpm test:node && pnpm test:web
